answer: An AI-agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to a network coordinate atlas. Participants must solve high-frequency latency challenges, signing responses with a falcon key while beacon nodes act as a digital quill to timestamp arrival metrics. This forces an attacker to provision discrete physical network links per identity instead of cheap virtual processes. However, transient routing fluctuations or bufferbloat can skew latency metrics, falsely rejecting honest agents.
